name: Anti-Chaos Recovery
trigger: AI output expanded faster than repository control
stop_conditions: repo state still changing without freeze

steps.name: Freeze changes
steps.notes: Pause unreviewed AI edits and establish one recovery owner.

steps.name: Create risk register
steps.notes: Capture active risks before cleanup or merge work starts.

steps.name: Create audit backlog
steps.notes: Open or update the audit backlog with recovery items first.

steps.name: Build evidence bundle
steps.notes: Assemble proof surfaces before any release or PR decision.

steps.name: Make release or hold decision
steps.notes: Use the release decision matrix after trust-check and PR readiness.
